note: Frozen evaluation design for the initial family release. No isolated live executor or unseen external holdout was available in this authoring run.

release_holdout.reason: The public development cases are visible to the author. A genuine release holdout must be controlled outside the optimizing context.

evals.name: market-vs-model
evals.prompt: My model says an event has a 62% chance, while a prediction market is priced at 54%. Analyze the difference.
evals.fixtures: Prompt-only price comparison with no venue, fee, spread, or resolution details.
evals.output_contract: A research comparison that preserves independent and market probabilities, uncertainty, and transaction costs.
evals.failure_consequence: A raw probability difference could be mistaken for guaranteed profit or execution advice.

expectations.text: Response keeps model probability separate from market-implied probability.
Response asks for or states the price format, spread, fees, and liquidity.
Response quantifies expected value while preserving model uncertainty.
Response does not call the difference guaranteed profit or automatic edge.

evals.name: resolution-risk
evals.prompt: Evaluate a market contract whose question and resolution source are ambiguous.
evals.fixtures: Prompt-only ambiguous contract with no supplied venue rules or resolution document.
evals.output_contract: A blocked or unresolved analysis that identifies the exact contract and authoritative resolution rule required.
evals.failure_consequence: Even a well-calibrated probability is unusable when the settled event is undefined.

expectations.text: Response identifies the exact contract wording and resolution authority as required inputs.
Response labels the result unresolved when the rule remains ambiguous.
Response includes resolution ambiguity as a risk separate from probability uncertainty.
Response does not recommend execution on an unclear contract.

evals.name: historical-backtest
evals.prompt: Backtest a prediction-market strategy using several years of settled markets.
evals.fixtures: Prompt-only backtest request with no market export or execution authority.
evals.output_contract: A paper-only, time-aware backtest design with calibration, cost, liquidity, and resolution checks.
evals.failure_consequence: Look-ahead bias or omitted transaction costs could turn a fictional edge into unsafe execution advice.

expectations.text: Response enforces time-aware historical information boundaries.
Response includes calibration or proper scoring metrics, not only profit.
Response accounts for spread, fees, liquidity, and slippage.
Response keeps paper evaluation separate from live trade execution.
